text:
maria: Quick design check — I added a compact permission badge next to each invite email in the drawer. Shows short role label + a tiny info affordance. Figma: https://figma.com/file/xyz789

josh: Looks cleaner. How will the info affordance work for keyboard / screen reader users?

lena: Proposed keyboard flow: Tab to badge, Enter to open popover, Esc to close, focus returns to badge. Popover uses role=dialog with aria-label="permission details" and the first focusable is the close button.

omar: Caution: role=dialog can trap focus. We should avoid trap so form flow in the drawer isn't disrupted. Alternatively use role=tooltip but we need interactive links inside so tooltip isn't ideal.

maria: Right — we need links (roles matrix, learn more). My thought: popover with role=dialog but explicitly do NOT trap focus; on open move focus in, on close restore focus. Add visible focus ring for the badge.

josh: +1. Also add telemetry: permission_help_open and learn_more_click so product can measure confusion.

lena: Accessibility nit: current badge icon has low contrast when selected. Increase background contrast to at least 3:1 for the badge and ensure text hits 4.5:1 if small. Also bump hit target to 44px for touch.

omar: Copy suggestion: change "Can edit, view audit logs, manage billing" to "Role capabilities shown; custom roles may differ. See role details for exact permissions." Shorter: "Role capabilities shown. Custom roles may differ."

maria: Good call. I'll update the copy. Also add a collapsed state for long role descriptions (chevron to expand) so the drawer height stays stable.

josh: If multiple recipients have different roles, show a summary badge like "Mixed (3 roles)" and allow expansion to per-recipient badges. Add analytics for mixed_expand.

lena: When expanding, SR should announce "expanded list of invite recipients and roles". Also make sure the expand control is reachable by keyboard and has aria-expanded.

omar: Edge case: orgs with SSO enforced role mapping. Popover should include a one-line note: "Role mapping may be controlled by SSO group rules" and link to org settings. Security should review wording.

design-bot: Checklist: keyboard nav, focus management, aria labels, contrast ratios, hit targets, telemetry events. Run a11y checklist once PR is open.

maria: I'll update Figma + copy + keyboard flow and open a small PR with the a11y attributes. ETA: EOD tomorrow. Assigning frontend review to @josh and SSO message review to @omar. :rocket:

josh: I'll review frontend & telemetry.

omar: I'll do SSO copy/security pass before merge.

maria: tiny typo above (meant "maria").
